title: Words prose no longer uses
description: Words this harness's narrative text has retired, each with the word that replaces it. Each code is the retired word as it is written; its label is what prose says instead. A retired word may still appear as a name: in code, in a link target, in a quotation, in a heading (its anchor), or joined to an identifier (`bean-coordination`, `beans/`, `bean/1.0.0`). Read by cat-harness-tools `scripts/retired-prose-words.ts`.
